(وَأَمَ) الْوَاوُ وَالْهَمْزَةُ وَالْمِيمُ. كَلِمَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلَى مُوَافَقَةٍ وَمُقَارَبَةٍ. يَقُولُونَ: الْوِئَامُ: الْمُوَافَقَةُ ; وَوَاءَمْتُهُ. وَمَثَلُهُمْ:

g: one who was born of a multiple birth, i.e. a twin, triplet, quadruplet, etc.
a pair of twins (two persons collectively)

وَاءَمَ • (wāʔama) III (non-past يُوَائِمُ (yuwāʔimu), verbal noun مُوَاءَمَة (muwāʔama))

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تَوَاءَمِي • (tawāʔamī) (form VI) /ta.waː.ʔa.miː/
# second-person feminine singular imperative of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
Dual form of تَوْأَم (tawʔam, “twin”). First attested in 929 as the name of the constellation.
